name: Dämmerung
source:
The mysterious Dämmerung is the first person Morgen meets when she awakens.
A man of few words, he brings her food and medication, encouraging her to eat and rest.
Despite showing concern, Dämmerung seems somewhat distant. Forever busy with "work".
Where does he go once Moren closes her eyes?

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/dawnofthedamned]Itch.io[/url]]
